name: Sonic Blade
description:
Powerful sword slashes create vacuum waves across the
ground. Effective against enemies outside of range.

name: Lightning Blade
description: Stabs foes and strikes them with lightning.

name: Swarm
description: Unleashes a barrage of thrusts.

name: Demon Hammer
description: A double slash from above and below.

name: Spiral Attack
description:
Performs a vicious spinning strike on the
enemy before running them through.

name: Tempest Strike
description: Performs a spinning slash to attack aerial enemies.

name: Twin Sonic Blade
description:
After performing Sonic Blade, two additional
blades of energy assault the enemy.

name: Super Lightning Blade
description:
Pierces the enemy with a wind-assisted strike
before hitting them with lightning.

name: Neo Swarm
description: Unleashes a barrage of countless thrusts.

name: Demon Twist
description: Performs Demon Hammer twice.

name: Double Spiral Attack
description:
After a spinning strike, rises upward
and knocks the enemy away.

name: Omega Tempest Strike
description:
Performs an aerial spinning slash while
unleashing blades of wind.

name: Demon Lightning Hammer
description:
A Sacred Skill that combines Demon Hammer and
Lightning Blade. Can be used after a Special Skill.

name: Neosonic Swarm
description:
A Sacred Skill that combines Sonic Blade and Swarm.
Can be used after a Special Skill.

name: Megasonic Thrust
description:
Sacred Skill. Powerful sword slashes
create multiple shockwaves.

name: Sonic Chaos
description:
Sacred Skill. Unleashes a barrage of
Sonic Blades in an instant.

name: Neo Tempest Swarm
description: A Sacred Skill that combines Neo Swarm and Tempest Strike.

name: Demon Spiral Hammer
description: A Sacred Skill that combines Spiral Attack and Demon Twist.

name: Omega Demon Chaos
description:
Unleashes a total of eight
strikes from above and below.

name: Rising Phoenix
description:
Covers the user in flames and rises into
the air before charging into the enemy.

name: Omega Seal
description:
Traps the enemy in an airborne prison of wind slashes.
Ineffective against heavy or aerial enemies.

name: Aurora Wall
description: Press 

name: Aurora Sword
description:
A lightning-quick sword slash that can be chained
after Aurora Wall by pressing 

name: Aurora Wave
description:
The power to protect all that you love. Use against
the Dark Aurora by holding down 

name: Palm Strike
description:
An energy-filled palm strike. Ground attack. Can be
chained into an anti-air or power attack.

name: Triple Blossom
description: Performs a triple kick with long reach. Ground attack.

name: Sonic Fist
description: A barrage of punches. Ground attack.

name: Swallow Dance
description:
A rising barrage of three kicks. Anti-air attack.
Can be chained into an aerial attack.

name: Eagle Dive
description:
A diving attack from air to ground. Aerial only attack.
Can be chained into a ground, anti-air, or power attack.

name: Rising Dragon Strike
description:
A double-handed punch that sends the
enemy into the air. Anti-air attack.

name: Twin Palm Strike
description: A powerful strike from both palms. Power attack.

name: Death Blossom
description:
A flying kick that can be chained into Triple Blossom.
Anti-air attack.

name: Super Sonic Fist
description:
Unleashes a series of Sonic Fists while teleporting.
Power attack.

name: Super Swallow Dance
description:
Sends the enemy even further into the air and can also
be chained from Swallow's Dance. Anti-air attack.

name: Eagle Rage
description:
A meteoric diving attack from the air to the ground.
Aerial attack.

name: Mirage
description:
Dodge enemy attacks like leaves dancing in the breeze.
Ground attack.

name: Lion's Howl
description:
Blasts the enemy back with fighting spirit.
Power attack.

name: Fatal Blow
description: A lightning-quick chain attack.

name: Healer
description: Restores a small amount of an ally's HP.

name: Detoxify
description: Cures an ally's Poison and Weakened.

name: Life
description: Revives a fallen ally.

name: Deadly Force
description:
A secret technique that unleashes an air-rending
shockwave that stops an enemy in their tracks.

name: ★ Undine
description:
Curative waters shall only grant their blessing
to those who do not cause harm.

name: ★ Sylph
description:
Those caught in the whirlwind find
themselves dropped into the abyss.

name: ★ Efreet
description: Blazing infernos will consume all trapped within.

name: ★ Gnome
description: Peerless protection granted by the lord of the earth.

name: ★ Celsius
description: Glacial blades that rip everything to shreds.

name: ★ Volt
description: An inescapable electromagnetic net.

name: ★ Rem
description:
Sacred light that grants salvation to
those who follow the right path.

name: ★ Shadow
description: An invitation into the depthless dark.

name: ★ Maxwell
description:
The power to control all the elements. The
flames of judgment will rise from the depths.

name: ★ Sekundes
description: Time itself shall come to a frozen standstill.

name: ★ Destiny
description: The wheel of fate sets in motion.

name: Heal
description: Water Craymel Arte. Moderately restores an ally's HP.

name: Nurse
description: Water Craymel Arte. Restores all allies' HP.

name: Cure
description: Water Craymel Arte. Significantly restores an ally's HP.

name: Restore
description: Water Craymel Arte. Restores HP of allies within the area.

name: Resurrection
description: Water Craymel Arte. Revives a fallen ally.

name: Recover
description:
Lightning Craymel Arte. Cures
the status ailments of an ally.

name: Charge
description:
Lightning Craymel Arte. Shares user's TP with an ally.
Defeating an enemy restores TP.

name: Deep Mist
description:
Dark Craymel Arte. Produces a mist
that lowers enemies' Accuracy.

name: Acid Rain
description:
Water Craymel Arte. Pours down acid
rain that lowers enemies' Resistance.

name: Sharpness
description: Fire Craymel Arte. Increases an ally's Attack.

name: Resist
description:
Ice Craymel Arte. Increases an
ally's Craymel Artes Defense.

name: Concentrate
description: Wind Craymel Arte. Increases an ally's Accuracy.

name: Barrier
description: Dark Craymel Arte. Increases an ally's Defense.

name: Holy Bliss
description:
Light Craymel Arte. Gradually restores HP equal
to the last amount of damage received.

name: Stagnation
description:
Time Craymel Arte. Increases the duration that
attacked enemies are frozen in time for.

name: Delay
description:
Time Craymel Arte. Interferes with enemy's Craymel
connection to increase their casting time.

name: Aqua Edge
description:
Low-level Water Craymel Arte. Creates a
small current that cuts down the enemy.

name: Spread
description:
Mid-level, low-power Water Craymel Arte.
Slices enemies with swirls of water.

name: Wind Blade
description:
Low-level Wind Craymel Arte. Creates
blades of wind around the enemy.

name: Air Thrust
description:
Mid-level Wind Craymel Arte. Fires
off a barrage of wind blades.

name: Cyclone
description:
High-level Wind Craymel Arte. Creates
a tornado around the enemy.

name: Fireball
description: Low-level Fire Craymel Arte. Shoots a fireball.

name: Eruption
description:
Mid-level Fire Craymel Arte. Creates
magma around the enemy.

name: Flame Wall
description:
Fire Craymel Arte. Places a fiery trap in front of the
target. Removed after using another Craymel Arte.

name: Explode
description:
High-level Fire Craymel Arte. Creates a
powerful explosion around the enemy.

name: Grave
description:
Low-level Earth Craymel Arte. Rocky
spears burst forth from the earth.

name: Stalagmite
description:
Mid-level Earth Craymel Arte. Summons
boulders from below the earth.

name: Ground Dasher
description:
High-level Earth Craymel Arte. Invokes
the destructive power of nature.

name: Ice Needles
description:
Low-level Ice Craymel Arte. Pierces
the enemy with needles of ice.

name: Freeze Lancer
description:
Mid-level Ice Craymel Arte. Runs the enemy through
with spears of ice. Can only be cast forward.

name: Blizzard
description:
Mid-level Ice Craymel Arte. Swallow
the enemy in a howling blizzard.

name: Absolute
description:
High-level Ice Craymel Arte. Freezes an enemy
in place by chilling them to their core.

name: Lightning
description: Low-level Lightning Craymel Arte. Rains down lightning.

name: Thunder Blade
description:
Mid-level Lightning Craymel Arte. Cuts the enemy
down with a blade made of pure lightning.

name: Indignation
description:
High-level Lightning Craymel Arte. Assaults the
area around the enemy with a lightning storm.

name: Ray
description:
Mid-level Light Craymel Arte. Rains down
countless heat rays around the enemy.

name: Holy Lance
description:
High-level Light Craymel Arte. Runs an enemy
through with countless spears of light.

name: Dark Force
description:
Mid-level Dark Craymel Arte. Creates a dark mass
that engulfs the area around the enemy.

name: Bloody Howling
description:
High-level Dark Craymel Arte. Rips the
enemy apart with an accursed howl.

name: Meteor Swarm
description:
Mid-level Elemental Craymel Arte.
Calls down a meteor shower.

name: Shooting Star
description:
High-level Elemental Craymel Arte. Calls down
a rain of countless shooting stars.

name: Distortion
description:
High-level Time Craymel Arte. Distorts space-time
itself to erase the enemy from existence.

name: Burning Force
description: Shoots a fireball that spreads flames.

name: Air Blade
description:
Shoots a rapid, spinning ball of
energy that shreds the enemy.

name: Aqua Spiral
description: Spears the enemy with intense water pressure.

name: Rage Laser
description: Shoots a powerful, thrumming beam of light.

name: Dark Laser
description: Emits a concentration of dark energy.

name: Elemental Master
description:
A devastating attack that utilizes
the energy of multiple Craymels.

name: Super Lightning Blade
description:
Pierces the enemy with a wind-assisted strike
before hitting them with lightning.

name: Neo Swarm
description: Unleashes a barrage of countless thrusts.

name: Dragon Swarm
description: Sacred Skill. Moves swiftly to unleash a flurry of slashes.

name: Dragon Flash
description:
Sacred Skill. A lightning-fast slash attack that
leaves the enemy seeing double.

name: Pow Hammer
description: Might knock an enemy unconscious with a pow.

name: Toss Hammer
description: Can poison an enemy with a powerful toss.

name: Ice Hammer
description: A blow that can freeze an enemy in place.

name: Roving Tool
description: A pirate's underling is still a pirate.

name: Para Ball
description: You don't want to play catch with this ball.

name: Eternal Throw
description: The one eternal truth is that nothing is eternal.

name: Spark Wave
description:
Lightning Craymel Arte. Discharges a powerful magnetic
field. Some practitioners of this Arte can even use it to fly.

name: Prism Sword
description:
Light Craymel Arte. Conjures a rainbow-colored
sword and strikes it into the earth.

name: +Mental Recharge
description:
Dormant Craymel Arte. Increases restored TP at
the end of a battle by 1%. Applies to all allies.

name: +Medical Boost
description:
Dormant Craymel Arte. Increases restored HP
from Craymel Artes during battle by 5%.
